title: 第45章 卖鱼的日子第46章 她是我儿媳妇
content_zh:
何彩云稍稍有些不好意思，脸颊都开始泛红了。
但她没有扭捏，立即就说道：“我刚才都跟你说了要卖鱼，可我一个妇道人家，实在是不好折腾……赵大爷你反正也没个固定工作，时间有的是，那你给我帮帮忙，和我一起去县城的农贸市场卖鱼行不？”
“你卖鱼赚到的钱分我不？”赵富贵问道。
“分你个蛋，你昨天给村长治疗一下子就赚了五万块钱呢，你就别惦记我这点辛苦钱了行不行？我……我一个离了三次婚的女人，连个可以依靠的男人都没有，你从我这里搜刮银子，叫我怎么活？”何彩云愤愤道，而且还露出凄苦的表情。
“我跟你开个玩笑你这么激动干嘛，好好好我答应你还不成么，你啥时候准备卖鱼，招呼我一声就行，我保证随叫随到。”赵富贵赶忙说道。
“后天就卖鱼，后天早上你早点过来，先帮我抓鱼，然后跟我一起去县城卖鱼。”何彩云说道。
“行，我知道了。”赵富贵苦笑着点点头。
话音一落赵富贵就转过身准备离开，可是何彩云又把他叫住。
“还有什么事儿？彩云妹子你能不能一次把话说完？”赵富贵十分头痛的说道。
好在何彩云这次没有为难赵富贵，她从水箱里把那三条四十厘米长的青斑鱼全捞出来，然后就装到一个大号塑料袋里，并把袋子塞到赵富贵的手里。
“这三条鱼是送你的，你带回家吃去。”何彩云说道。
“你这么好心？”赵富贵说道。
“你不要就还给我！”
何彩云说着就要抢夺，赵富贵连忙提着袋子朝远处狂奔。
“那我就谢谢你的好意了，彩云妹子！”
赵富贵头也不回的大笑着说道，眨眼间的功夫就已经跑远了。
刚刚回到家里，赵富贵就听见厨房里传来了一阵锅碗瓢盆的声音，不用猜也能知道是陈慧兰来了。
果不其然，赵富贵刚刚进入屋子来到厨房门口，就看到陈慧兰正在围围裙，一副马上就要动手做饭的架势。
“富贵你到哪去了？”陈慧兰好奇的问道。
“何彩云鱼塘里的鱼病了，她叫我过去给鱼看病哩。”赵富贵笑呵呵的说道。

“你还会给鱼看病？”陈慧兰更好奇了。
“这有什么难的，别人也许看不了，但我肯定能成。”
赵富贵说着就走进厨房，将手里的袋子提起来给陈慧兰欣赏。
陈慧兰立马就发出一声惊呼：“好大的青斑鱼，还是三条！这是何彩云给你的？你把她的鱼治好了？”
“这不是显而易见的嘛，我要是没治好她鱼塘里的鱼，她别说送我三条青斑鱼了，不给我大逼斗都算好的了。”赵富贵笑道。
“这下咱们有口福了！”
陈慧兰从赵富贵的手里接过袋子，笑的满脸桃花开。
到了中午陈雪涵就过来了，看到桌子中央摆着的那一大盆鱼汤，她就哇哇的叫了起来。
“今天怎么吃的这么丰盛啊，居然弄了这么大一盆鱼！”陈雪涵吃惊的喊道。
“快吃吧你，别问东问西了。”陈慧兰笑道。
content_en:
He Caiyun was a little embarrassed, and his cheeks began to turn red.
But she didn't hesitate and said immediately: "I told you just now that I want to sell fish, but I am a woman and it's really hard to deal with it...Uncle Zhao, you don't have a regular job anyway, and you have plenty of time. Then help me and go to the farmer's market in the county with me to sell fish, okay?"
"Will I share the money you earn from selling fish?" Zhao Fugui asked.
"Fuck you, you made 50,000 yuan by treating the village chief yesterday, so don't worry about my hard-earned money, okay? I... I am a woman who has been divorced three times, and I don't even have a man I can rely on. How can I live if you take money from me?" He Caiyun said angrily, with a miserable expression on his face.
"I'm just kidding you, why are you so excited? OK, okay, I promise you. When are you going to sell fish, just say hello to me. I promise to be there when you call." Zhao Fugui said quickly.
"I will sell fish the day after tomorrow. You come here early the day after tomorrow, help me catch fish first, and then go to the county town with me to sell fish." He Caiyun said.
"Okay, I understand." Zhao Fugui nodded with a wry smile.
As soon as he finished speaking, Zhao Fugui turned around and was about to leave, but He Caiyun stopped him again.
"Is there anything else? Sister Caiyun, can you finish the sentence at once?" Zhao Fugui said with a headache.
Fortunately, He Caiyun did not embarrass Zhao Fugui this time. She fished out all three 40-centimeter-long blue groupers from the water tank, then put them into a large plastic bag, and stuffed the bag into Zhao Fugui's hand.
"These three fish are given to you. You can take them home and eat them." He Caiyun said.
"Are you so kind?" Zhao Fugui said.
"If you don't want it, just give it back to me!"
He Caiyun said that he was going to snatch it, and Zhao Fugui quickly picked up the bag and ran towards the distance.
"Then I thank you for your kindness, Miss Caiyun!"
Zhao Fugui said with a smile without looking back, and ran away in the blink of an eye.
As soon as he returned home, Zhao Fugui heard the sound of pots and pans coming from the kitchen. He didn't need to guess to know that it was Chen Huilan who was here.
Sure enough, as soon as Zhao Fugui entered the house and came to the kitchen door, he saw Chen Huilan putting on an apron, as if she was about to start cooking.
"Where have you been, Fugui?" Chen Huilan asked curiously.
"The fish in He Caiyun's fish pond was sick, and she asked me to go over and treat the fish." Zhao Fugui said with a smile.
"Can you still treat fish?" Chen Huilan was even more curious.
"What's so difficult about this? Others may not be able to see it, but I can definitely do it."
Zhao Fugui walked into the kitchen as he spoke and lifted the bag in his hand for Chen Huilan to admire.
Chen Huilan immediately exclaimed: "What a big blue grouper, or three! He Caiyun gave this to you? Did you cure her fish?"
"Isn't this obvious? If I hadn't cured the fish in her pond, she wouldn't have given me three blue grouper fish, and it would be fine if she didn't give me a big fight." Zhao Fugui said with a smile.
"Now we're in for a treat!"
Chen Huilan took the bag from Zhao Fugui's hand, smiling with peach blossoms on her face.
Chen Xuehan came over at noon, and she screamed when she saw the large basin of fish soup placed in the center of the table.
"Why did you eat so richly today? You actually got such a big basin of fish!" Chen Xuehan shouted in surprise.
"Eat quickly, don't ask questions." Chen Huilan said with a smile.
